comments.value: The feature you're looking for already exists, it's called Groups. Manage them at https://vrchat.com/home/groups. It'll sync.

details:
Currently, VRChat only provides three Favorite Friends lists, which becomes rather limiting for users with large friends lists or friends from multiple communities.

Third-party applications such as VRCX already offer additional ways to organize friends into custom groups. However, these groups aren't accessible through VRChat's in-game Social menu.

This means that if I want to find someone belonging to a custom VRCX group, I still have to search through my VRChat friends list or switch to VRCX.

 # Suggested features

1. **Custom friend groups:** Allow users to create, rename, organize, and delete additional friend groups beyond the existing three Favorite Friends lists.

2. **In-game filtering:** Make these groups accessible directly through VRChat's Social menu, in both Desktop and VR modes.

3. **Import/export support:** Allow importing existing friend-group memberships from VRCX through a supported format such as JSON or CSV, without manually recreating every group.

4. **Multiple group assignments:** Allow one friend to belong to several groups simultaneously.

5. **Optional synchronization:** Ideally, allow changes made in external applications to synchronize with VRChat, using an officially supported interface.

# Example use case

I might have separate friend groups for staff members of communities I moderate, people I've met in specific worlds, avatar creators, and personal friends.

VRCX can help organize them, but if those categories aren't available in VRChat itself, their usefulness is limited while playing.

# Why this would be useful

The goal isn't simply to increase the number of friends that can be favorited. It's to make larger friends lists easier to organize and navigate, regardless of whether users are playing in Desktop or VR mode.

Even if direct VRCX synchronization isn't feasible, supporting a documented import/export format would be a useful starting point.

This could also benefit users who don't use VRCX by providing better native friend organization.
title: [Feature Request] Custom Friend Groups, In-Game Filtering & VRCX Import Support
